_comment: Minimal scenarios for harvestcore. Pins clock advance + animal hunger rise. Harvestcore is a complex farming sim — these scenarios cover the most fundamental cascades; deeper coverage (crops, sales, weather) would be follow-up.

scenarios.name: clock_advances_time
scenarios._: Time-of-day field on world_clock should change after 50 ticks.

scenarios.name: animal_hunger_rises_when_unfed
scenarios._: Reset chicken hunger + fed_today=0 (didn't eat). After 100 ticks, hunger should accumulate.
